fields.summary: Test Analysis: Regressions disappear when variant filters are applied
fields.description:
h2. Summary

The regressions list in the Test Analysis page (implemented in TRT-2273 / [openshift/sippy#3775|https://github.com/openshift/sippy/pull/3775]) incorrectly returns empty results when variant filters are added.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

1. Navigate to the Test Analysis page for a test with known active regressions, e.g. `[sig-apps] job-upgrade` on release 5.0
2. Observe that the Issues widget shows regressions (no variant filters applied)
3. Add a variant filter such as `Platform:gcp` (with `has entry`)
4. Observe that all regressions disappear from the list

h2. Expected Behavior

When variant filters are applied, the regressions list should show only regressions whose variants match the applied filters — not an empty list.

h2. Actual Behavior

All regressions disappear when any variant filter is added.

h2. Reproducer URL

[Test Analysis page with Platform:gcp filter|https://sippy-auth.dptools.openshift.org/sippy-ng/tests/5.0/analysis?filters=%257B%2522items%2522%253A%255B%257B%2522columnField%2522%253A%2522name%2522%252C%2522operatorValue%2522%253A%2522equals%2522%252C%2522value%2522%253A%2522%255Bsig-apps%255D%2520job-upgrade%2522%257D%252C%257B%2522columnField%2522%253A%2522variants%2522%252C%2522not%2522%253Atrue%252C%2522operatorValue%2522%253A%2522has%2520entry%2522%252C%2522value%2522%253A%2522never-stable%2522%257D%252C%257B%2522columnField%2522%253A%2522variants%2522%252C%2522not%2522%253Atrue%252C%2522operatorValue%2522%253A%2522has%2520entry%2522%252C%2522value%2522%253A%2522aggregated%2522%257D%252C%257B%2522columnField%2522%253A%2522variants%2522%252C%2522not%2522%253Afalse%252C%2522operatorValue%2522%253A%2522has%2520entry%2522%252C%2522value%2522%253A%2522Platform%253Agcp%2522%257D%255D%252C%2522linkOperator%2522%253A%2522and%2522%257D&test=%5Bsig-apps%5D%20job-upgrade]

h2. Root Cause Hypothesis

The variant filter parameters are likely not being correctly passed to or processed by the regressions API query. The filtering logic may be requiring an exact match on all variants rather than checking if the regression's variants contain/intersect with the filtered variants.

h2. References

* [TRT-2273|https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/TRT-2273] — parent feature issue
* [openshift/sippy#3775|https://github.com/openshift/sippy/pull/3775] — implementing PR
